title: Flexible Proof-State Product Launch Film
mechanism: A compressed launch film behaves as a flexible proof state machine rather than a fixed storyboard: an outcome, operation, internal mechanism, maximum contrast event, breadth proof and final action may be merged or reordered as long as each state answers a new product question. A strict material, light and typography system maintains coherence while shot count, information order, camera carrier and breadth device change across instances.

invariants.rule: Within the first third, establish one emotionally legible outcome and its causal relationship to the product; outcome-first and proof-first openings are both valid.
invariants.purpose: Gives technical information a human consequence without prescribing a brand-hero first frame.
invariants.ablation_failure: If the product and outcome never connect, the sequence becomes either abstract mood or disconnected documentation.

invariants.rule: Make each information state answer a different product question, but merge related questions and vary their order according to the new product's strongest causal proof.
invariants.purpose: Turns speed into cumulative proof instead of a montage of interchangeable beauty shots.
invariants.ablation_failure: If adjacent beats repeat the same claim, the fast pace becomes empty and the product remains vague.

invariants.rule: Concentrate one maximum contrast event after enough setup to make it legible; the peak may be physical, spatial, typographic or human, and its position is variable.
invariants.purpose: Creates a memorable second hook without requiring oversized text or a fixed midpoint boundary.
invariants.ablation_failure: Equal intensity across all states produces a flat montage; repeating a source-style giant-text peak exposes the borrowed surface.

invariants.rule: Bind different modules with one strict contrast system, typography behavior and recurring assembly physics.
invariants.purpose: Maintains brand coherence while people, interfaces and use cases change rapidly.
invariants.ablation_failure: Unrelated palettes, transitions or type treatments make the film feel like stock fragments.

invariants.rule: Prove breadth once before the final action using a device native to the new concept—continuous space, physical transformation, one montage, radial staging or audience behavior—not a mandatory card row or grid.
invariants.purpose: Converts a singular proof into broader relevance without locking the template to one information design.
invariants.ablation_failure: No breadth proof makes the product feel niche; repeating cards then grid reproduces a specific campaign storyboard.

invariants.rule: Keep all visible copy short, complete and motion-safe: text lands at final size on a cut or via a hard mask and remains sharp long enough to read.
invariants.purpose: Protects comprehension in a dense 15-second information sequence.
invariants.ablation_failure: Scaling, warping or partially formed words compete with the product proof and create spelling artifacts.

slots.name: product_identity
slots.constraint: One original fictional product name and a single-sentence emotional promise.

slots.name: hero_benefit_image
slots.constraint: An original person, object or environment showing the desired outcome rather than the interface.

slots.name: capability_modules
slots.constraint: Two or three visually distinct proofs that answer different product questions.

slots.name: operation_proof
slots.constraint: One legible control, process or physical mechanism that demonstrates how the product works.

slots.name: peak_event
slots.constraint: One maximum contrast event expressed through physical, spatial, typographic or human change.

slots.name: breadth_device
slots.constraint: One original non-redundant method for proving multiple contexts; avoid the source card-row plus grid pair.

slots.name: graphic_system
slots.constraint: A palette, material, light behavior and typography rule unrelated to the source campaign.

slots.name: final_action
slots.constraint: One concise CTA displayed in a stable closing lockup.

slots.name: information_order
slots.constraint: Choose an order derived from the new product's causal logic, not the source's nine-state sequence.

slots.name: shot_structure
slots.constraint: Use five to eight states with materially different boundaries, merges and camera implementations.

anti_copy_exclusions: MiniMax H3, HailuoAI, Create Beyond, LIVE RIGHT NOW, AVAILABLE NOW and every other source string
source woman, violet jellyfish, nebula, purple speed streaks and identical product-category imagery
source wordmarks, logos, translucent panel compositions, editing interface and creator-card layouts
the exact nine-panel storyboard, exact beat durations, exact typography positions and source color palette

instantiations.concept: A fictional compact air-quality device called AERIA ONE uses six reordered states: live room control proof, early sleeping-child outcome, combined sensor-filter macro, a physical apartment-scale clean-air peak with no giant text, one continuous environment morph for breadth, and a quiet final lockup.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Six-state proof-first clean-air launch with early human outcome, physical spatial peak, continuous non-card breadth morph and stable CTA.

instantiations.concept: A fictional modular field battery called NORTHSTAR GRID uses five states in a single storm environment: rescue outcome first, physical cell stacking, live cable routing across the same set, the floodlights becoming the visual peak, and a wide operational tableau carrying a small DEPLOY NOW lockup without use-case cards.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Five-state single-location energy launch with outcome-first causality, physical assembly, lighting peak and no category grid.

instantiations.concept: A fictional adaptive running shoe called KINETIC ARC uses seven asymmetrical states: runner impact outcome, sole pressure trace, foam macro, terrain transition, the athlete clearing one stair as the physical peak, three matched footfalls across surfaces, and a ground-level final action.
instantiations.prompt_seed: Seven-state performance launch whose breadth is carried by matched footfalls rather than panels or grids.

failure_modes.failure: The film is only a sequence of attractive product shots.
failure_modes.repair: Assign each beat a distinct question and require an observable proof before the next cut.

failure_modes.failure: Every beat tries to be the visual climax.
failure_modes.repair: Use restrained assembly motion early, one dominant kinetic peak, then simplify toward the CTA.

failure_modes.failure: Typography becomes unreadable or dominates the product.
failure_modes.repair: Limit copy, land it complete at final size, hold it sharp and keep moving effects behind the text plane.

failure_modes.failure: A palette swap leaves the source campaign visibly recognizable.
failure_modes.repair: Change product category, hero subject, materials, information order, shot count, camera implementation, breadth device, copy and final action in addition to color.

transfer_tests.concept: A fictional compact air-quality device called AERIA ONE uses six reordered states: live room control proof, early sleeping-child outcome, combined sensor-filter macro, a physical apartment-scale clean-air peak with no giant text, one continuous environment morph for breadth, and a quiet final lockup.
